<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>3.4.1</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>

    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>demo</artifactId>
    <version>0.0.1-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <name>demo</name>
    <description>Spring Boot JPA/Hibernate demo</description>

    <properties>
        <java.version>21</java.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-web</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-validation</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.h2database</groupId>
            <artifactId>h2</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId>
            <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

spring.application.name=demo

# --- Default (development): in-memory H2 ---
spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:mem:demodb;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1
spring.datasource.driver-class-name=org.h2.Driver
spring.datasource.username=sa

spring.jpa.show-sql=true
spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.format_sql=true
spring.jpa.open-in-view=false

Scaffolded the project. Structure:

```
pom.xml                                  Spring Boot 3.4.1, Java 21, data-jpa, web, validation
src/main/
  java/com/example/demo/
    DemoApplication.java                 entry point
    customer/Customer.java               JPA entity
    customer/CustomerRepository.java     JpaRepository (+ derived queries)
    customer/CustomerService.java        @Transactional service
    customer/CustomerController.java     REST endpoints
  resources/application.properties       H2 default; PostgreSQL config commented
src/test/java/.../CustomerRepositoryTest.java   @DataJpaTest
.gitignore
```

Notes:
- Defaults to in-memory H2 (`/h2-console`) so it runs out of the box; uncomment the PostgreSQL block in `application.properties` for a real DB.
- `spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=update` is dev-only; switch to `validate` with migrations for production.
- Java and Maven aren't installed in this environment, so I couldn't run `mvn test`. Once available: `mvn spring-boot:run`, then `POST /api/customers` with `{"name":"...","email":"..."}`.
